--- title: "SSF Formulations" author: "Scott Forrest" date: "2025-09-15" execute: cache: false bibliography: paperpile.bib toc: true number-sections: false format: html: # self-contained: true code-fold: show code-tools: true df-print: paged code-line-numbers: true code-overflow: scroll fig-format: png fig-dpi: 300 pdf: geometry: - top=30mm - left=30mm editor: source abstract: | In this script we demonstrate different approaches to including covariates in an SSF model. --- # Load required packages ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(tidyverse) packages <- c("amt", "sf", "terra", "RColorBrewer") walk(packages, require, character.only = T) ``` ::: # Import data and clean ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} buffalo_data <- read_csv("data/buffalo.csv") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` New names: Rows: 133161 Columns: 11 ── Column specification ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── Delimiter: "," chr (2): node, dates dbl (7): ...1, lat, lon, height, accuracy, heading, speed dttm (2): timestamp, DateTime ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data. ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message. • `` -> `...1` ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # remove individuals that have poor data quality or less than about 3 months of data. # The "2014.GPS_COMPACT copy.csv" string is a duplicate of ID 2024, so we exclude it buffalo_data <- buffalo_data %>% filter(!node %in% c("2014.GPS_COMPACT copy.csv", 2029, 2043, 2265, 2284, 2346)) buffalo_data <- buffalo_data %>% group_by(node) %>% arrange(DateTime, .by_group = T) %>% distinct(DateTime, .keep_all = T) %>% arrange(node) %>% mutate(ID = node) buffalo_clean <- buffalo_data[, c(12, 2, 4, 3)] colnames(buffalo_clean) <- c("id", "time", "lon", "lat") attr(buffalo_clean$time, "tzone") <- "Australia/Queensland" head(buffalo_clean) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} tz(buffalo_clean$time) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] "Australia/Queensland" ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} buffalo_ids <- unique(buffalo_clean$id) ``` ::: # Create a step object Use the `amt` package to create a trajectory object from the cleaned data. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-summary="Create a trajectory object"} buffalo_all <- buffalo_clean %>% mk_track(id = id, lon, lat, time, all_cols = T, crs = 4326) %>% transform_coords(crs_to = 3112, crs_from = 4326) # Transformation to GDA94 / # Geoscience Australia Lambert (https://epsg.io/3112) ``` ::: ## Plot the data spatially ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} buffalo_all %>% ggplot(aes(x = x_, y = y_, colour = id)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.1) + coord_fixed() + scale_x_continuous("Easting (m)") + scale_y_continuous("Northing (m)") + scale_colour_viridis_d() + theme_classic() + theme(legend.position = "right") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](exploratory_temporal_dynamics_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png) ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # ggsave("outputs/data_prep/buffalo_djelk_map.png", # width = 150, height = 150, units = "mm", dpi = 600) ``` ::: ## Pick out a single individual ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} which_buffalo <- "2022" # select a single buffalo ID buffalo_id <- buffalo_all %>% filter(id == which_buffalo) buffalo_id %>% ggplot(aes(x = x_, y = y_, colour = t_)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.1) + coord_fixed() + scale_x_continuous("Easting (m)") + scale_y_continuous("Northing (m)") + theme_classic() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](exploratory_temporal_dynamics_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png) ::: ::: ## Create steps We will just use a steps object here for now ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} buffalo_id_steps <- buffalo_id %>% steps() head(buffalo_id_steps) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: # Import spatial covariates Although NDVI changes over time, and we have access to monthly layers, we will just select a single month here. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ndvi <- rast("mapping/ndvi_aug_2018.tif") plot(ndvi, main = "NDVI August 2018") points(buffalo_id$x_, buffalo_id$y_, col = "red", pch = 16, cex = 0.5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](exploratory_temporal_dynamics_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-6-1.png) ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ndvi ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` class : SpatRaster dimensions : 2280, 2400, 1 (nrow, ncol, nlyr) resolution : 25, 25 (x, y) extent : 0, 60000, -1463000, -1406000 (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax) coord. ref. : GDA94 / Geoscience Australia Lambert (EPSG:3112) source : ndvi_aug_2018.tif name : ndvi min value : -0.5441047 max value : 0.8086554 ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} canopy <- rast("mapping/canopy_cover.tif") herby <- rast("mapping/veg_herby.tif") slope <- rast("mapping/slope_raster.tif") spatial_covs <- c(ndvi, canopy, herby, slope) names(spatial_covs) <- c("ndvi", "canopy", "herby", "slope") plot(spatial_covs) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](exploratory_temporal_dynamics_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png) ::: ::: ## Extract covariate values at the end of each step ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} buffalo_id_steps <- buffalo_id_steps %>% extract_covariates(spatial_covs, where = "end") head(buffalo_id_steps) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ## Prepare data for extracting covariate information ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} buffalo_id_steps <- buffalo_id_steps %>% mutate(t1_ = lubridate::with_tz(buffalo_id_steps$t1_, tzone = "Australia/Darwin"), t2_ = lubridate::with_tz(buffalo_id_steps$t2_, tzone = "Australia/Darwin")) buffalo_id_steps <- buffalo_id_steps %>% mutate( # id_num = as.numeric(factor(id)), # step_id = step_id_, x1 = x1_, x2 = x2_, y1 = y1_, y2 = y2_, t1 = t1_, t1_rounded = round_date(t1_, "hour"), hour_t1 = hour(t1_rounded), t2 = t2_, t2_rounded = round_date(t2_, "hour"), hour_t2 = hour(t2_rounded), hour = ifelse(hour_t2 == 0, 24, hour_t2), yday = yday(t1_), year = year(t1_), month = month(t1_), sl = sl_, log_sl = log(sl_), ta = ta_, cos_ta = cos(ta_), canopy_01 = canopy/100) ``` ::: ### References ::: {#refs} :::
